generate_flamegraph_memory: generate a flamegraph visualizing CUDA memory usage from a pickled memory snapshot
generate_flamegraph_segments: generate a flamegraph showing memory allocation details per allocator segment from a snapshot
generate_flamegraph_compare: generate a flamegraph comparing two CUDA memory snapshots to show added or removed segments
summarize_segment_allocation: summarize how CUDA allocator segments are filled and report fragmentation statistics
generate_memory_trace: generate a Pythonic trace output of allocation and deallocation events from a memory snapshot
generate_html_trace_plot: generate an HTML visualization of memory usage over time from a CUDA memory trace snapshot
generate_html_segment_plot: generate an HTML visualization of allocator segment state history from a CUDA memory snapshot
generate_html_profile_plot: generate an HTML visualization of memory usage from a kineto memory profile
